attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.help: Pending, excused, and unmarked people are not absences. Cancelled events and events that do not count are excluded. People who are not on the list are not marked absent.

participation.title: Participation
participation.explain: A period chooses which events are in the set. Inside that set, pending, excused, unmarked, cancelled, and events that do not count are excluded. Someone not on an event list is not given an absence.
participation.groupRule: With a group selected, a person counts on an event only if their membership covered that event's date.
participation.pooledRule: The combined percentage uses the same formula on the summed counts. It is not an average of each person's percentage.
participation.empty: Add a period and some events to read participation.
participation.showSkipped: Show events where the person was not on the list

volunteers.notAllowed: Volunteer states cannot change on a cancelled event.

rules.title: Rules
rules.attendanceBody: Percentage = present / (present + absent). If there is no present and no absent, the percentage is empty, not zero. Pending, excused, and unmarked participants are excluded. Cancelled events are excluded. Events flagged as not counting are excluded. People who are not on that event's list are excluded, and Adê does not create an absence for them. Inactive people still count for past events they were on. A group filter adds one more test: the person must have belonged to the group on the event date.
rules.volunteerBody: Only active people are suggested. Earlier events are those with an earlier date. Completed work weighs the most, then recent completion, the same component, and earlier attendance. Interest in the current event adds points but does not select anyone. Declines and volunteer absences subtract points. The final selection is always manual, and it stops at the volunteer capacity. Selected and completed occupy a place. Interested, declined, and absent do not.
rules.statesBody: A person can be marked interested or selected directly. Interested can become selected or declined. Selected can become completed, declined, absent, or interested again. Completed can return to selected. Declined can return to interested. Absent can return to selected. Each change is kept in the record history.
rules.collabBody: Every change in a space is a revision you can undo, redo, or show again. Export a space to another Adê. New records are added. Identical records stay as they are. If both sides changed the same record, neither version is discarded: both are stored on a conflict, and the local one remains active until you keep local, use the other version, or keep both as a separate copy.
rules.docsBody: A template can place literal or bound text, an image, and flowing columns. Columns continue on new pages. A background PDF is drawn behind each page. The PDF uses the same participation figures as the participation screen.

error.ATTENDANCE_NOT_ALLOWED: Attendance is recorded on scheduled or completed events.
error.VOLUNTEER_NOT_ALLOWED: Volunteer states cannot change on a cancelled event.
error.PERSON_NOT_PARTICIPANT: That person is not on the event list.

error.ASSET_IN_USE: A template still uses that file.
